answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in prism and gale lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the ripple graph. A farm of 3551 identities would post 3362 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
